question: The famous musician, Appa Jalgaonkar is associated with which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harmonium.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Appa Jalgaonkar** played the **harmonium.**
 
• He was well-known as accompanist of **singer Bhimsen Joshi.**
 
• **Amir Khan, Bade Ghulam Ali Khan, and Hirabai Barodekar** were some of the **singers** with whom Appa Jalgaonkar collaborated.
 
• He was given the **prestigious Sangeet Natak Akademi Award **for his accomplishments in harmonium playing.
 
• On **September 16th,** he passed away in **Pune at the age of 87.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Harmonium:**

 
 
• It is a **free-reed keyboard** instrument.
 
• It emits sound when air is forced through **metal reeds screwed over slots** in metal frames with close tolerance by** foot-operated bellows** through a **pressure-equalizing air reservoir.**
 
 
 
• **Tabla:**
 
 
• It is the most widely used instrument for **dance, vocal, and instrumental music.**
 
 
 
• **Sarod**:
 
 
• It is a stringed musical instrument of the lute family that is common to the **Hindustani music.**
 
 
 
• **Violin:**
 
 
• It is a **wooden chordophone,** a **type of string instrument.**
